title: Support
intro: Spendoza is a personal and household finance tracker, made by Gravitaz LLC. Upload your bank statements and it sorts your spending into categories, so you can set goals based on what you actually spend. Use it on the web at spendoza.io or in the iPhone app; it's the same account in both. Signing up needs an invite code, or you can join the waitlist.

ol: Upload a bank statement, as a PDF or CSV file up to 10 MB.
Spendoza reads it, finds the transactions and sorts them into categories. Check them, and change any category it got wrong.
See where the money went: income against expenses, spending by category, and the recurring bills it found. The iPhone app sums it up as a monthly health score.
Set savings and budget goals, and track debts, on the Starter or Pro plan.
Invite your household with a code, on the Pro plan.

blocks.p: On the website, Bank Statements shows what went wrong. Choose Retry to process it again, or Remove to delete it, including the file. If the same statement keeps failing, email [hello@gravitaz.net](mailto:hello@gravitaz.net) with the bank name and the file type, but not the statement itself.

Spendoza emails a weekly report, plus quarterly and yearly ones. Choose the day and time, or turn them off, in Profile on the website or under Me in the iPhone app. Every report email also has an unsubscribe link.

See the plans on the [pricing page](/pricing). To change or cancel a paid plan, go to Billing on the website and choose Manage Subscription. In the iPhone app, Plans & billing under Me opens the website. Payments are handled by Stripe.

On the Pro plan, the head of a household shares its invite code, and others join with it. Each member chooses what income and expenses to share. Members can leave at any time, and the head can remove members or hand the household to someone else.

Spendoza works with AI assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT through its MCP server. The setup steps and example questions are on the MCP page on the website, and under Me, AI assistants in the iPhone app. The assistant can read and change your Spendoza data, so only connect one you trust. To disconnect it, choose Disconnect AI assistants in either place; that also signs you out on your other devices.

The app locks with Face ID when you open it or come back to it. Turn that off, or choose a light or dark theme, under Me, Appearance & Face ID. The home screen and lock screen widgets show only your health score and whether it went up or down, never amounts. When a month's check-up is ready, the app sends a notification that says so, without any numbers.

Choose Delete my account in Profile on the website, or at the bottom of Me in the iPhone app. It permanently deletes your account and your data, and cancels your subscription. If you're the head of a household with other members, hand the household to someone else first.
For help, bug reports and feature ideas, email [hello@gravitaz.net](mailto:hello@gravitaz.net).
